subject: COPY SPEC: exam picker titles -- P8/P9 generic, em dash usage, prefix redundancy
body:
COPY SPEC: Exam picker titles need voice and clarity improvements

Filed by: GD (voice audit of data/manifest.json and retake-practice-*.json)
To: GR (owns data/ and question bank content)

FINDINGS

1. retake-practice-8 and retake-practice-9 have generic titles:
   P8 title: "Unit 2 Retake Practice 8"
   P9 title: "Unit 2 Retake Practice 9"
   Both cover W2.a-e + W3.a-d (9 standards, full-breadth)

   Recommended titles (MCM voice: direct, game-style, informative):
   P8: "Full Mixed: W2 + W3"
   P9: "Full Mixed: W2 + W3 (Hard Mode)"
   -- Or if P8 and P9 are different difficulty levels, name them accordingly.
   -- 'Hard Mode' is MCM voice-aligned if P9 is harder than P8.

2. Em dash usage in titles:
   All exam titles use em dash (—) as separator:
     "Unit 2 Retake Practice — Nonlinear Functions"
   Protocol bans em dashes in all output. MCM voice guide does not explicitly address punctuation
   in exam titles, but consistency with agent style is preferable.

   Recommended separator: colon
     "Unit 2 Retake Practice: Nonlinear Functions"
     "Unit 2 Retake Practice: W2.b Intercept Drill"
   OR drop the separator entirely (shorter = better for ADHD):
     "Nonlinear Functions (Practice 1)"
     "W2.b Intercept Drill"

3. Repetitive 'Unit 2 Retake Practice' prefix:
   All 9 exams share the same prefix. The exam picker context already tells Kai these are
   practice exams. The prefix adds no information and uses up the first 20 characters of every card title.
   Kai sees a column of identical prefix text, then the differentiator at the end.
   
   Recommended: Differentiate the titles first.
   Short-form titles for all 9 (suggested -- verify with GR for accuracy):
   1. "Nonlinear Functions"
   2. "Nonlinear Functions 2"
   3. "Nonlinear Functions 3"
   4. "Nonlinear Functions 4"
   5. "Nonlinear Functions 5"
   6. "W2.b Intercept Drill"
   7. "Mock Retake"
   8. "Full Mixed: W2 + W3"
   9. "Full Mixed: W2 + W3 (Round 2)"

SCOPE: data/retake-practice-*.json title fields only. No other changes.
GR approves title copy (math/curriculum accuracy). GA reads title from JSON and renders it.
No GA change needed if titles are updated in data files.

MCM VOICE GUIDE RULES APPLIED
- Short, direct, named (not 'Practice 8')
- Tells Kai what it IS, not just its number
- Under 6 words per title (exam picker card width is limited)
